effect_boundaries.action: POST the approved create preview to the fixed repository Issue endpoint.
effect_boundaries.authority: Trusted host approval plus the configured GitHub actor for quekou-fde-development/fde-development.
effect_boundaries.precondition: Preview repository and operation are accepted, preview_sha256 matches a current approval, request_id has no conflicting journal revision, no matching remote marker exists, and required labels exist.
effect_boundaries.idempotency_key: request_id marker feedback-request:request_id; content fingerprint is a secondary duplicate detector.
effect_boundaries.checkpoint_before: CREATE_INTENT is durably written in the request journal before POST.
effect_boundaries.receipt_after: CREATE_RECEIPT stores the created Issue number before independent Issue readback; COMMITTED stores the final receipt.
effect_boundaries.readback: GET the exact Issue and compare title, body, and required labels; locate markers through Issues readback before a retry.
effect_boundaries.compensation: manual_verdict; never delete a possibly created public Issue automatically.

effect_boundaries.action: POST an approved ordinary supplemental comment or approved maintenance decision comment to a fixed Issue.
effect_boundaries.authority: Trusted host approval for an ordinary comment, or trusted host approval from config.maintainer_approvers plus a configured maintainer GitHub actor for a maintenance decision.
effect_boundaries.precondition: The target is a real Issue in the fixed repository, preview_sha256 matches approval, and no matching feedback-comment or feedback-update marker exists.
effect_boundaries.checkpoint_before: COMMENT_INTENT is durably written in the request journal before POST.
effect_boundaries.receipt_after: COMMENT_RECEIPT stores comment_id; COMMITTED stores the current Issue receipt and comment_id after comment-list readback.
effect_boundaries.readback: List Issue comments and match both marker and approved body, then read the Issue for the final receipt.
effect_boundaries.compensation: manual_verdict; do not automatically edit or delete a public comment.

effect_boundaries.action: PATCH the approved Issue state, state_reason, status label, and assignees after its maintenance decision comment has been read back.
effect_boundaries.authority: Trusted host approval from config.maintainer_approvers and a configured maintainer GitHub actor.
effect_boundaries.precondition: The approved update comment is present, current state/labels/assignees equal the preview before values, and the request journal has no unresolved non-PREPARED phase.
effect_boundaries.idempotency_key: request_id marker feedback-update:request_id plus an exact post-PATCH comparison to the approved patch.
effect_boundaries.checkpoint_before: PATCH_INTENT is durably written in the request journal before PATCH.
effect_boundaries.receipt_after: PATCH_RECEIPT is written after PATCH; COMMITTED stores the read-back state receipt.
effect_boundaries.readback: GET the Issue and compare state, state_reason, labels, and assignees to the approved patch.
effect_boundaries.compensation: manual_verdict; preserve other-user changes and never auto-rollback a public Issue.

recovery.lock_owner_identity: Each journal attempt persists attempt_id and actor; writer.lock is a process-scoped POSIX fcntl lock, and RemoteEffectAdapter captures the expected attempt and fence for each effect lifecycle call.
recovery.fencing_rule: Each local attempt increments entry.fence. RemoteEffectAdapter construction and _guard reject mismatched request key, attempt, or fence before any lifecycle method; GitHub itself has no distributed fence-token endpoint.
recovery.stale_lock_rule: Current fcntl lock releases on process exit. There is no durable stale-lease takeover protocol; multi-host writers remain disabled.
recovery.resume_selector: Current recovery is selected by caller-supplied request_id and remote marker lookup. It does not select the globally earliest unfinished transaction.
recovery.no_progress_rule: Current code has one local writer and no parallel worker coordinator, persistent progress deadline, bounded wait count, or remaining-only fallback. This required strict-contract field is intentionally recorded as absent.
recovery.commit_rule: Write COMMITTED only after the relevant remote marker and required final Issue state are independently read back.
recovery.unlock_rule: Exit the Journal context to release the local fcntl writer lock after return or exception.

durability.journal: Journal.put writes request_id JSON with atomic replace, file fsync, directory fsync, and restrictive local permissions.
durability.commit_receipt: The COMMITTED journal entry stores the result receipt after remote readback.
durability.evidence_retention: operations.md requires journal and approval retention through the Issue lifecycle and audit period; current code has no automated retention enforcement.

blocking_facts: The canonical transaction kernel is scripts/kernel.py::apply_transaction with seven parameters; the production entrypoint is scripts/entrypoints.py::apply_feedback_effect.
Three concrete boundary types remain: create Issue, add comment, and patch Issue; the maintenance decision comment shares the add-comment effect type.
